data.name: 盲盒指挥官
data.detailed_description:
Welcome to Blind Box Commander!

Blind Box Commander is a toy-brick-inspired real-time strategy game that combines out-of-match deckbuilding, in-match blind box draws, and classic base-building tech tree progression. Build your base, expand your economy, unlock new technology, deploy your forces, and adapt on the fly as each match presents a different mix of possibilities. Victory belongs to the commander who can turn uncertainty into advantage.

In Blind Box Commander, the battle begins before the match even starts.
Before entering combat, you build your own strategic deck by choosing 24 cards from a pool of nearly one hundred buildings, units, and facilities. That deck determines what you might draw during the match and shapes your overall game plan. You can build a deck around armored pushes and direct pressure, or lean into economy, defense, or surprise tactics. Every commander can develop a style of play that feels distinct.

Once the match begins, the real unpredictability kicks in.
Unlike a traditional RTS where you can rely on fixed build orders, the options available in each battle are revealed gradually through the game’s signature blind box system. The buildings, units, and facilities you can use all come from the deck you prepared beforehand, but what you draw — and when you draw it — can dramatically change your priorities. You may need to stabilize your economy, fortify key positions, contest important territory, or seize a timing window and launch an attack. Base expansion and tech progression remain at the heart of the experience, but the rhythm of each match is shaped by the combinations you uncover.

That is what gives Blind Box Commander its unique appeal.
On one hand, it delivers the classic satisfaction of real-time strategy: building a base, commanding armies, controlling the map, and engaging in direct combat. On the other, the uncertainty of blind box draws forces you to reassess the battlefield, rework your plans, and discover new opportunities in real time. Strategy is not diminished by randomness here — it is sharpened by it. Success depends on both smart deck construction and decisive adaptation under pressure.

Powered by Unreal Engine 5, the game presents its battlefield through a vivid toy-brick visual style.
From bases to combat units, everything is designed to feel playful, readable, and full of character, while still preserving the tension and clarity that a strong RTS demands. This is not a world of gritty realism, but a battlefield built from toy bricks where offense, defense, economy, and tactical mind games still matter at every moment.

Key Features

Build Your Strategic Deck
Choose 24 cards from nearly one hundred buildings, units, and facilities to shape your strategic pool for each match. Different deck compositions support different playstyles, so the mind game begins before the battle does.

Open Blind Boxes Mid-Match
Your in-match options come from the deck you built, but the order and timing of each draw can redefine your strategy on the spot. Every match creates new combinations, and every draw can change the course of battle.

Classic RTS Base and Tech Tree Gameplay
Expand your base, gather resources, unlock technology, produce units, scout the map, pressure your opponent, and push your advantage in a familiar real-time strategy framework with a fresh twist.

Adapt in Real Time
No fixed plan survives every draw. You will need to evaluate your options quickly, shift your priorities, adjust your tempo, and turn uncertainty into tactical opportunity.

Multiple Battle Modes
From 1v1 and 2v2 to 4-player and 8-player free-for-all battles, the game supports a range of match formats, whether you prefer tight duels, coordinated teamwork, or larger and more chaotic battlefields.

A Growing Strategic Sandbox
Beyond player-versus-player combat, the game will continue expanding with additional challenge content and creative gameplay possibilities, giving players even more ways to explore new strategies and battlefield experiences.

Are you ready, Commander?
Build your deck, open your blind boxes, establish your base, and lead your toy-brick army to victory in a battlefield where no two matches unfold the same way.

data.short_description: Blind Box Commander is a toy brick-style RTS with deckbuilding, blind box draws, and classic base tech. Build a 24-card deck, expand your base, unlock units, and adapt your tactics in real time as every match delivers new combinations and fresh strategic battles.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4590 / AMD equivalent
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 / AMD equivalent
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: 1080p, Low to Medium settings recommended for stable performance.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10/11 64-bit
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-8400 / AMD Ryzen 5 2600
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1650 / AMD RX 5500 XT
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 3 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX compatible
  • Additional Notes: 1080p, High settings recommended.
